method: Independent model. No prediction, odds or xG figures from any prediction site are used. Inputs are real events only: goals scored/conceded in league matches this season (league tables), the league's goals-per-match average, and team news. Confirmed absences adjust a team's attack by the stated multiplier. Rumours are listed separately, labelled UNVERIFIED, and are given a multiplier of 1.0 (no effect) unless confirmed by a club.
